name: Alhama de Granada (Spain)
description: Green field with a red bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alhama de Granada (a castle on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Alhama de Granada; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
